title: Hearts Burning on the Road
question: What were they shown that made the Scriptures suddenly burn?
blurb: Two travellers, one stranger, and the whole of Scripture opened up.

nodes.content: What were they shown that made the Scriptures suddenly burn?

nodes.verseText: They asked each other, “Were not our hearts burning within us as He spoke with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?”
And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, He explained to them what was written in all the Scriptures about Himself.
You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,
Then Philip began with this very Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.
If I say, “I will not mention Him or speak any more in His name,” His message becomes a fire burning in my heart, shut up in my bones, and I become weary of holding it in, and I cannot prevail.
